The '''''Dream Runner''''' was a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 gunship]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
The ''Dream Runner'' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]],<ref name="Stats" /> officially designated the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 gunship]].<ref name="Model" /> 120 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the ''Dream Runner'' operated as an anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]], armed with eight double [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons and four [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|launchers]] for [[Capital ship/Legends|ship]]-to-ship combat, and six [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] for starfighter screening. Equipped with a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], the ''Dream Runner'' was capable of achieving speeds of 1,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and possessed a Class 2 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] for [[Lightspeed/Legends|faster-than-light]] travel with a slower Class 16 unit as a backup. The ''Dream Runner'' had storage space for 300 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo aboard, and could carry eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] worth of consumables.<ref name="Stats" />

==History==
The ''Dream Runner'' served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], assigned to the [[Trax Sector Force]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it participated in the [[battle of Bissillirus]] alongside its sister ship, the [[Corellian Thunder (DP20 gunship)|''Corellian Thunder'']], and the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Defector]]''.<ref name="Showdown" />
